% pgfplots oracle fixture (hand-written): legend below the axis in one row,
% legend style at/anchor/draw/fill, every even column sep, reverse legend.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[xlabel=$x$, legend columns=-1, reverse legend,
  legend style={at={(0.5,-0.15)}, anchor=north, draw=none, fill=yellow!20,
    /tikz/every even column/.append style={column sep=0.3cm}}]
\addplot coordinates {(0,0) (1,1)};
\addplot coordinates {(0,1) (1,0)};
\addplot coordinates {(0,0.5) (1,0.5)};
\legend{up,down,flat}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
